# Toko Academy

> Toko Academy is a digital skills training academy based in Jimeta-Yola, Adamawa
> State, Nigeria. It teaches software engineering, data analysis, artificial
> intelligence, cybersecurity, digital marketing and foundational digital
> literacy to young people, working professionals, children and public
> institutions — mostly in North-East Nigeria, and online.

Tagline: "Skills for Tomorrow".

Toko Academy runs three kinds of work from one place:

- **Open programmes** anyone can enrol on, delivered blended (in person in
  Jimeta-Yola plus online) or fully self-paced.
- **Children and youth programmes** for ages 6–18, including Scratch
  programming, web basics and holiday bootcamps.
- **Institutional training** for companies, government agencies, regulators and
  development organisations, designed around the client's own objectives and
  delivered on site or remotely.

Programmes are organised into six schools: Digital Literacy, Software
Engineering, AI & Emerging Technologies, Data Science & Analytics, Digital Media
& Creative Tech, and Kids & Youth. Teaching is project-based and certificated.
Delivery is in English.

The academy's wider programming is framed around eight thematic areas mapped to
the UN Sustainable Development Goals, covering digital literacy, advanced
technology and software engineering, data and evidence-based decision-making,
workforce development and entrepreneurship, children and youth technology
education, gender equality and inclusion, public sector capacity building, and
climate and green digital skills.

Location: No. 1A Bekaji Road, adjacent to the YEDC S/C Office, Jimeta, Yola,
Adamawa State, Nigeria.
Email: info@tokoacademy.org
Phone: +234 808 825 6055, +234 812 856 1493

- [Class schedules](https://tokoacademy.org/schedules/): When cohorts and classes run.
- [Kids & teens](https://tokoacademy.org/kids/): Coding and computer programmes for ages 6–18, with parent FAQs.
- [Corporate training](https://tokoacademy.org/corporate/): Tailored workforce training and IT consultation for organisations and government.
- [Partners](https://tokoacademy.org/partners/): How partnerships work, and who the academy already works with.
- [Impact](https://tokoacademy.org/impact/): Outcome figures, the monitoring and evaluation framework, and case studies.
- [Thematic areas](https://tokoacademy.org/thematic-areas/): The eight programme pillars and their SDG alignment.
- [Contact](https://tokoacademy.org/contact/): Phone, email, address and enquiry form.

## Programmes currently offered

Each links to its page, where the current fee, hours and delivery mode are
listed. Fees are not repeated here so that this file cannot go out of date.

- [Digital Foundations](https://tokoacademy.org/courses/digital-foundations/): Core digital literacy and productivity for workplaces and public offices.
- [Python Programming](https://tokoacademy.org/courses/python-programming/): Programming from first principles through to building working applications.
- [Web Development Foundations](https://tokoacademy.org/courses/web-development-foundations/): Self-paced introduction to building for the web.
- [JavaScript Fundamentals](https://tokoacademy.org/courses/javascript-fundamentals/): Self-paced JavaScript, from beginner to modern JavaScript.
- [Full Stack Web Development](https://tokoacademy.org/courses/web-development/): Front end through back end, building and shipping complete applications.
- [Cybersecurity Fundamentals](https://tokoacademy.org/courses/cybersecurity-fundamentals/): Security foundations for professionals and institutional teams.
- [AI Essentials](https://tokoacademy.org/courses/ai-essentials/): Practical everyday use of AI tools for work and study.
- [AI Chatbots & Workflow Automation](https://tokoacademy.org/courses/ai-powered-chatbots/): Building chatbots and automating real business workflows with AI.
- [Data Analysis & Visualization](https://tokoacademy.org/courses/data-analysis-visualization/): Turning data into decisions, with analysis and visualisation tooling.
- [Digital Marketing and Content Creation](https://tokoacademy.org/courses/digital-marketing/): Marketing, content and creative production for the digital economy.
- [Scratch Programming](https://tokoacademy.org/courses/scratch-programming/): Block-based programming for children and young learners.
- [Zero to Live](https://tokoacademy.org/zero2live/): A two-day, in-person workshop in Jimeta-Yola where participants build an app with AI and put it live at a real domain.
